title: Prepare the existing whole-document writer qualification adapter without live dispatch
root_cause: The existing qualification adapter encodes the earlier one-Synthesize protocol. synthesis_only permits one completion and 64 delegated preflights; generate_with_control separately hardcodes one Synthesize. The whole writer has multiple initial sections, budget-search probes and optional Saturated children. Reusing the old adapter unchanged would stop before it exercises the new writer. This is a test-adapter protocol mismatch, not evidence of a model limit or an app defect.

required_change_surface.change: Extend the existing shared budget owner with an explicit whole-writer qualification mode; preserve old modes and defaults. Require validated finite per-stage/completion/preflight limits. Reserve before delegation under the existing shared stop state; no refund or reset.

Add a test-only preparation/recorder entry through the existing production whole-document policy and source/planning/progress/assembly owners. Reuse the configured product runtime factory and supervisor pattern; do not implement an alternative writer, schema, framing or parser. Preparation uses the accepted offline counter and never constructs a live runtime.

Add an explicitly non-dispatching writer preparation mode that binds the combined source, frozen inputs, runtime configuration and exact planned requests. Require the existing seven-owner offline receipt. The later live mode and dispatch authorization are separate scope.

explicit_non_scope: No production source behavior, prompt, schema, model, framing, seed policy, settings or capacity changes.
No model server, GPU work, tokenization HTTP calls or generation.
No Analyze or Verify generation; no whole-pipeline, supported-output or fidelity claim from preparation.
No use of benchmark fact contents or DV labels to tune generation.
No new public PR push, ready transition, merging into any published frozen branch, hold clearance or production adoption.
assumptions_blockers: Both frozen documents must use their existing source identities. The preparation must enumerate which valid persisted Analyze artifacts satisfy the unchanged stage entry; if unavailable or stale, report that prerequisite and do not synthesize invented analysis or silently run Analyze.

Whole-writer admission and Saturated splitting can change later request bodies and allowances. Initial offline requests with test seed 7 are capacity evidence, not automatically the production run-seed requests.

Before any live scope, freeze the deterministic run IDs, native profile/model/server/libraries/tokenizer, exact request serialization, finite completion and preflight limits, and every approval consumed by the before-send gate.
Every initial or response-dependent request must be approved under the later accepted body-gate policy before dispatch; unknown children are not pre-approved by these initial counts.
Stack placement and delta-review plan must preserve independent PR141/143 review and PR132 freeze; local combined tree is not reviewed integration.
verification_plan: Fail-first public probes at the existing shared budget owner: explicitly admitted multiple writer completions and measured-scale preflights must not inherit the historical one/64 limits.

Negative twins: non-writer stages, zero or invalid limits, past-the-max, changed frozen request, duplicate reservation, failure/cancellation and concurrent calls must not delegate or reset spend. Existing native_stages and synthesis_only behavior stays unchanged.
Preparation invokes no runtime factory/startup/health/generation; source, input, profile, seed or receipt mismatch stops before dispatch.
Reuse exact existing seven-owner frozen lane on the final implementation head. Do not add a bespoke fidelity scorer.
Validate launcher/output-parent ownership using existing evidence output helper and tests; no recursive creation or existing-evidence overwrite.

live_authorization.later_budget: Not yet requested. Initial section totals are not a completion ceiling; optional split children and admission searches must be counted from the accepted run mode before operator approval.

implementation_summary: Contract only. The unchanged combined source passed the frozen seven-owner lane, zero model calls/startups, and86 readiness tests. No qualification-adapter implementation or live request authorization.
cold_diff_audit: No authored source changes. The local merge tree combines only the two reviewed follow-up deltas.

data_dependent_request_bound.scope: Writer generation only; finite planning ceiling, not an authorized live budget or predicted spend.
data_dependent_request_bound.derivation: Each initial primary section is a nonempty disjoint ordered set of source units. split_saturated halves that primary set into two nonempty children. Each node is dispatched once. For U primary source units and S initial roots, there are at most U leaves and 2*U-S total nodes, including saturated parents. No extra consolidation generation: current finalize_progress calls deterministic assemble. Stops can occur sooner.
data_dependent_request_bound.qualification_requirement: Recompute U and S for the final reviewed source and production run seed before any live scope; freeze actual source IDs and initial bodies. These rows use the accepted offline count seam and seed7, not a native measurement. Each later child or claim-budget readmission needs its own request binding and approval. Native preflights are counted separately; their live limit remains unrequested.

whole_document_reference.recorded_result: Corrected native adapter reproduced both saved outputs byte-for-byte in two calls, normal stop, no retries. This proves same-input reproducibility and capacity, not complete-fidelity gold.

current_writer_differences: Versioned complete normalized source and owned dependency/contextual citation registry instead of flat text. Source identities and coverage are frozen, not sampled.
Atomic-claim JSON with exact source IDs, unchanged1200-scalar text and8-source per-unit boundaries, document claim ceiling64 instead of freeform brief.
Capacity-admitted sections with initial and data-dependent child requests, persisted progress and deterministic assembly; no model consolidation call.

Current pinned native product factory: one slot, offload999, private-socket completion transport and already repaired message/thinking framing. These settings are established port decisions; do not rerun a setting experiment here.
Production generation_seed_for_run remains authoritative. Offline seed7 is only capacity evidence; do not substitute it or historical default4294967295.
Actual per-request schema/output allowance is produced by the existing budget owner. Do not apply the historical1500 allowance to the new shape.
Independent frozen fact-coverage/fidelity review after generation; original freeform parity and unchanged C9/SAME60 stay separate regression scopes.
proven_preproduction_baseline.no_new_departures: The adapter may observe, freeze and enforce these existing choices. Any additional departure requires an explicit contract revision before implementation.
